subject: Function-address-identifier
notes: 'Function-address-identifier creates a unique data item of class pointer and category function-pointer that contains the address of a function identified by one of the following: a) the content of the data item referenced by identifier-1 b) function-prototype-name-1.' BOTH arms are live and both are witnessed: the 2014 golden takes the PROTOTYPE arm and the 2023 golden drives the IDENTIFIER arm three times. The 'unique data item of class pointer and category function-pointer' is the resolved FunctionPointer value the emitted site computes once and stores into every receiver - it is a value, never a declared item, which is why it has no PicInfo and why SR3 keeps it out of receiving positions. GR1's trailing sentence ('Identifier-1 shall reference a function prototype specified in the REPOSITORY paragraph') is a RUN-TIME fact about the identifier's CONTENT, not a compile-time screen on the identifier, and it is exactly what GR4 answers when the content names nothing.
